leafer-js-skill v0.1.1

- No file or documentation changes detected in this release.
- No new features, fixes, or updates were introduced.

Initial release – comprehensive support for LeaferJS Canvas engine.

- Provides detailed setup and usage instructions for LeaferJS across Web, Vue, React, Next.js, Node.js, Web Worker, and WeChat Mini Program environments.
- Includes quick start examples, integration guidance, and project initialization steps for various frameworks and use cases.
- Lists core concepts, key features, and recommended application scenarios for professional-grade graphics editing and interactive development.
- Offers troubleshooting notes and best practices to ensure optimal performance and integration.
